## Observed behavior

Describe what happened, including the visible message or API response.

## Expected behavior

Describe the correct chess rule or application behavior.

## Reproduction

the problem.

## Evidence

Include relevant JSON, a screenshot, or command output. Remove cookies, tokens, local paths, and any
personal data.
